releaseNote.summary: r41 shipped June 19: routines are back, the Slack formatting fix is live, OAuth app improvements, Meta v3 CLI, multi-account integrations, and more. r42 is in draft.
releaseNote.plannedWindow: r41 shipped June 19, 2026. r42 is in draft.
releaseNote.details: r41 (June 19, 2026) included the routines refactor (routineth), the Slack 'internal formatting error' fix (PDEC-8168), stale app OAuth fix (PDEC-8266), Meta v3 creative transcripts and summaries, v3 tag migration, multi-account Pipedream integrations, the scoped secret delete endpoint, the tenant-scoped app resolver, expanded creator search/filtering/sorting, usage breakdown exposure, and a batch of Spawneth and backend stability improvements. r42 is now in draft.

runnethUseOptions.use_when_relevant: Use this whenever the user's request touches this area.
runnethUseOptions.only_when_asked: Use this only when the user asks about or reports this issue.
runnethUseOptions.status_page_only: Visible to CSMs, product, and operators, but not injected into Runneth by default.

resolutionOptions.confirmed_next_release: Confirmed for the next planned release.
resolutionOptions.working_toward_next_release: Working toward the next planned release, but not marked ready yet.
resolutionOptions.in_progress: Being worked on, but not tied to the next planned release.

resolutionOptions.resolved: Fixed and shipped. Stays at the bottom of the board for about a day (through removeAfter) so it is visible and gets pulled into the next summary, then drops off.

notices.summary: OAuth-gated apps can show a rough logged-out screen.
notices.impact: When someone opens an app that requires OAuth while logged out, the gated screen may look unfinished instead of showing a polished sign-in or access prompt.
notices.workaround: Log in to the right Motion/Runneth account, connect the required OAuth account if needed, then reopen or refresh the app link.

resolution.label: Fix in review
resolution.note: A fix for the logged-out screen (an access-denied page) is in review and targeted for the next release.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Show under Apps. This is a logged-out OAuth gate UI issue, not a general app outage. Use the in_progress resolution flag and do not imply it is confirmed for the next planned release.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks about or reports an app, app link, dashboard, widget, or generated page looking broken, ugly, unfinished, or confusing while logged out or blocked by OAuth.
notices.runnethGuidance: Acknowledge that OAuth-gated apps can show a rough logged-out screen, that the underlying data is fine, and that a fix (an access-denied page) is in review and targeted for the next release. Do not proactively mention this for normal requests.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture the app link, whether the person was logged out, which OAuth gate appeared, and whether the page still looks wrong after logging in and refreshing.

notices.impact: The routines refactor shipped in r41 (June 19). Routines are live again.
notices.workaround: No workaround needed. Routines can be created and scheduled normally.

resolution.label: Resolved
resolution.note: Resolved. The routines refactor (routineth, PR #2116) shipped in r41 on June 19, 2026. Routines are live. Existing routines were migrated as part of the release. Saved routine plans can now be turned on.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Show as resolved. Routines shipped in r41 on June 19.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks to create, set up, schedule, monitor, remind, notify, post later, repeat, keep something updated, or run background upkeep.
notices.runnethGuidance: Routines are live as of r41 (June 19). Create and schedule routines normally.
notices.supportGuidance: Routines shipped in r41 on June 19. Existing routines were migrated. If someone's routine isn't behaving as expected, check whether it was saved as a plan (not yet created) or was already live before the refactor.

notices.summary: The Slack 'internal formatting error' line is fixed.
notices.impact: The fix (PDEC-8168, PR #2313) shipped in r41 on June 19. Runneth no longer surfaces an 'internal formatting error' line in Slack in place of a real reply.

resolution.label: Resolved
resolution.note: Resolved. The fix for missing Slack responses from terminal output (PDEC-8168, PR #2313) shipped in r41 on June 19, 2026.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Resolved. Show at the bottom briefly, then drop off after removeAfter.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks about or reports an 'internal formatting response' error in Slack, or Runneth posting an error line after being told to stop.
notices.runnethGuidance: The Slack formatting error fix shipped in r41 (June 19). If someone is still seeing the error, ask them to retry in a new Slack thread and flag it as a new occurrence.
notices.supportGuidance: Fixed in r41 (June 19). If a new report comes in after June 19, capture the Slack thread link and thread start time.
notices.errorQuote: I hit an internal formatting error while preparing this Slack response. Please try again.
